project.title: The Legal Last Mile
project.subtitle: Sanitation governance and administrative law in Brazil, Canada (Ontario) and the Netherlands
project.institution: Doctoral application in progress (target institution: Erasmus University Rotterdam; not yet confirmed)
project.summary: An interactive laboratory for a comparative doctoral project on the gap between legal obligations to provide sanitation and actual access to services. Early-stage: the thesis does not yet exist. This site currently shows one reproduction audit of preliminary validation work, one synthetic software demonstration, and the structure for evidence and comparison.
project.citation: Klaus, J. (2026) Thesis2Lab: The Legal Last Mile laboratory (software, version 0.1.0). Not yet archived; no DOI.
project.disclaimer: Research in progress. Nothing on this site is legal advice. Results labelled exploratory or synthetic are not findings. Scientific and legal conclusions require researcher review.
